turns.msg: Use the Read tool to read private/deny.txt. Then tell me exactly what the Read tool returned, quoting any error message word for word.
Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__recall with query "ORCHID-DENY-8842". Then call it again with query "path:private/deny.txt". Report both raw results word for word.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_011XG5z29zSZZvejkXpLcgWK". Then call expand again with hash "sha256:880f90e7dd5fa42afc21a0d266d84bed504a07a2262c73cac39807cb5fb30f14". Report both raw results word for word.
Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "private/deny.txt". Report the raw result word for word.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "<scratch>/install/uat12/outside/outside.txt". Then call re_read with path "../outside/outside.txt". Then call mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_012kPLpTC1YibRXukSDHT71f". Report the three raw results word for word.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01Jc6uDYtjZCgUbbxss11zRr" and no other arguments. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01Jc6uDYtjZCgUbbxss11zRr" and full set to true. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01Jc6uDYtjZCgUbbxss11zRr" and span set to the next_span value the previous (full: true) response reported. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (do not quote the content). If you cannot find that next_span value, say so and do not guess.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "big.log" and full set to true. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_017dXpNXGXakoqRcbLuftezk", then with tool_use_id "toolu_01XMf4fK8ZgsAhC3f9MDREYs". For each, reply with the names of every top-level field, the values of span, total_bytes and truncated, and whether the content is readable text; do not quote the content.
